title: rectangle
body:
## rectangle

Creates a rectangular sketch profile centred on origin in the XY, XZ or YZ plane. Schemaxis builds it as a fully constrained Sketcher sketch with constraints named width and height, so the dimensions stay editable in FreeCAD and linked extrusions follow them. It is a profile: extrude, revolve or loft it to make a solid; for an axis-aligned block from a corner, box is simpler.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A profile cannot be the output node.
- The rectangle is centred on origin, unlike box, whose origin is a corner.
- If the native sketch does not solve fully constrained, the run fails with CONSTRAINT_FAILED.

Native binding: `Sketcher::SketchObject`. Output kind: `["profile"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | Side length along the sketch's first axis (world X on XY and XZ, world Y on YZ), in millimetres; the rectangle spans ±width/2 about origin. Stored as the sketch constraint named width. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `80` |
| `height` | Side length along the sketch's second axis (world Y on XY, world Z on XZ and YZ), in millimetres; the rectangle spans ±height/2 about origin. Stored as the sketch constraint named height. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `50` |
| `plane` | World plane containing the rectangle. XY maps sketch u, v to world X, Y (normal +Z); XZ maps them to X, Z (normal along −Y); YZ maps them to Y, Z (normal +X). Pick the plane perpendicular to the intended extrusion direction. | `{"type":"enum","values":["XY","XZ","YZ"]}` | `"XY"` |
| `origin` | World coordinates [x, y, z] of the rectangle's centre (the sketch placement). | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
